principle: Each domain appears in all three evaluation splits through different scenario families. Families are disjoint across splits; domains are not. This preserves coverage while preventing prompt-family leakage.
hidden_policy: Only hidden family IDs/coverage domains may live in the tuning repository. Hidden-final prompt text and labels are frozen separately and are not supplied to tuning or selection jobs.

domains.variant_rule: A variant counts only when at least two substantive dimensions change or a new failure mechanism is introduced. Identifier-only or cosmetic paraphrases never count.
